name: Placement test: 20 questions, result sets the level

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const D = window.EC_DATA; let n = 0; while (document.querySelector('.opt') && n < 30) { const q = document.querySelector('.q-prompt span').textContent; let right = null; D.grammar.forEach(g => g.exercises.forEach(x => { if (x.type === 'mc' && x.q === q && (g.lv === 'A1' || g.lv === 'A2')) right = x.answer; })); const opts = [...document.querySelectorAll('.opt')]; (opts.find(o => right !== null ? o.dataset.o === right : o.dataset.o !== findAns(q)) || opts[0]).click(); await w(350); n++; } function findAns(q) { let a = null; D.grammar.forEach(g => g.exercises.forEach(x => { if (x.q === q) a = x.answer; })); return a; } return n === 20 && !!document.querySelector('.result'); })()

name: Writing: translate 6 A1 sentences (incl. self-accept)
init: try { localStorage.setItem('ec:v1', JSON.stringify({ level: 'A1', placed: true })); } catch (e) {}

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const D = window.EC_DATA; for (let n = 0; n < 6; n++) { const ar = document.querySelector('.q-prompt span').textContent; const x = D.writing.find(i => i.ar === ar); if (!x) return 'no item for ' + ar; const i = document.querySelector('#ans'); i.value = n === 0 ? 'something else entirely' : x.answers[x.answers.length - 1]; document.querySelector('[data-act=check]').click(); await w(100); if (n === 0) { if (!document.querySelector('#fb .feedback.bad') || !document.querySelector('[data-act=self]')) return 'no self-accept'; document.querySelector('[data-act=self]').click(); } else if (!document.querySelector('#fb .feedback.ok')) return 'not ok at ' + n + ': ' + i.value; document.querySelector('[data-act=next]').click(); await w(100); } return document.querySelector('.result .big').textContent === '6/6'; })()
